name: Glockenhof
beschreibung: The Glockenhof in Walchsee is a complex with several holiday apartments. The accommodations have separate bedrooms, a living area and a kitchenette. The complex is in a quiet location on the outskirts of Walchsee, near the Walchsee and the Kaisergebirge. In summer, the surrounding area is ideal for hiking, cycling and swimming excursions. In winter, the ski areas of SkiWelt and at the Zahmer Kaiser are quickly reachable. The holiday apartments are suitable for couples and families who want to spend an independent holiday. A car parking space is available directly at the house for most units. A garden or a sunbathing lawn is available for guests to use communally.
